lines.en: My little pick hangs at my belt.
I walk over the rubble.
I carry the smell of gold.
I follow along the cave wall.
I step around a pit.
I carry a few ore chunks.
I stop and pick up stones as I go.
My boot soles are worn thin.
I head deeper in.
I can see fine in the dark.
I waddle along.

lines.zh: 我蹭到石壁上，掉了一层灰。
lines.en: I brush the wall and shed a layer of dust.
I bounce the ore in my arms.

lines.zh: 我抱着矿石，朝洞口的光走。
lines.en: Hugging my ore, I walk toward the cave mouth's light.
I stop at a fork.
I crouch by an ore vein.
I scrape the stone with a nail.
I listen to the echoes.
I count the ore in my arms.
My headlamp is dim.
I look up at the ceiling.
I sniff the rock.

lines.zh: 我在想这一块值多少钱。
lines.en: I wonder what this piece is worth.
I set the pick by my feet.
My teeth are yellow.
I have dug nothing.
I dig at my ear.
I get up and move elsewhere.
I scratch my chin.

lines.zh: 我把一块石头翻过来看。
lines.en: I turn a stone over to look.
You are standing on my shaft entrance.
You will not get the gold in my arms.
You are very tall.

lines.zh: 我看看你手里有没有镐。
lines.en: I check whether you carry a pick.
This is our cave.
I shrink back.
You are not here to mine, are you?
I am deciding whether to shout for others.
Do not go down there.
I grin.
Do you want to trade for gold?
I cry out and cover my head.
My ore falls.
I roll to the wall.
Blood runs from my nose.
I bare my teeth and shrink back.
I clutch the wound.
My pick flies from my hand.
This wound is bearable.
Gold? Bring it closer and let me see.
I will take that.

lines.zh: 你要是给金子，什么都好说。
lines.en: Give gold and anything can be discussed.
I reach out to take it.
Do not fob me off with junk stone.
I bite it; it is real.
This would trade for two picks.
I tuck it into my waistband.
I grin wide.
You are all right.
That is mine now.
I stuff it into my arms.
Let me look again.
Do not pull your hand back.

lines.zh: 你撞到我，矿石掉了一地。
lines.en: You knock into me and ore scatters.
I am short and get bowled over.
I scramble to pick up the stones.
My pick falls.
You stepped on my foot.
I hug your leg to keep from falling.
We make a loud collision.

lines.zh: 洞里的粗金，我先看见了。
lines.en: I saw the raw gold in this cave first.
My headlamp is askew.
Do not push; I am carrying things.
There is a whole nest down here.
We guard this vein together.
She keeps gold under her pillow.
We count ore until midnight.
She calls me lazy.

lines.zh: 我把最好的那块给了她。
lines.en: I give her the best piece.
The lamp dies and we keep counting.
At dawn we go back to digging.
There are echoes in the cave.
I crouch and pick it up.
This one has good color.
I tuck it into my arms.

lines.zh: 掉在地上的亮东西，都归我。
lines.en: Anything shiny on the ground is mine.
I blow the dirt off.
I weigh it; heavy enough.
I bite it.
I put it in the sack and tie it.

lines.zh: 这块金子成色好，我留着。
lines.en: This gold is good quality; I keep it.
Do not reach for it.
You want my gold.
I raise my pick.
Everyone in the cave will hear.
I charge at you.
I bare my teeth.
The gold is mine.
Every gold vein in the cave is mine.
I am ready to swing.
My shadow moves on the wall.
I follow over the rubble.
I spin the pick in my hand.
You took the wrong tunnel.
Keep off the raw gold in my cave.
It is dark here; you are not used to it.

lines.zh: 我抱着金子，贴着你身后走。
lines.en: Clutching my gold, I shadow you.
The gold is mine — and so is your life.
I swing the pick into your leg.
I headbutt you.
I cling to your leg.
That swing went wide.
The blow drops you to your knees.
I snatch at your things.
I kick your shin.
I spit in your face.
You take another step.
I squeeze out of the shaft mouth.
My pick is still dusty.
This vein is mine.

lines.zh: 我身上的口袋沉甸甸的。
lines.en: My pockets are heavy.
I open my eyes in the dark.
I stand up behind the rubble.
I have not finished this layer.
I shoulder the pick.
Someone is coming; I hear them.

lines.zh: 火在洞里烧起来，我往后跳。
lines.en: Fire breaks out in the cave and I leap back.

lines.zh: 我从矿道掉下去，摔在石堆上。
lines.en: I drop down a shaft onto the rubble.

lines.zh: 地下水淹过来，我拼命划。
lines.en: Groundwater floods in and I paddle hard.

lines.zh: 爆炸把矿道震塌了一角。
lines.en: The blast caves in part of the tunnel.

lines.zh: 箭扎进背里，粗金还挂着。
lines.en: The arrow is in my back; the raw gold still hangs.
A flash of light and my eyes swim.
Too hungry to lift the pick.

lines.zh: 雷声从洞口传下来，我缩起来。
lines.en: Thunder rolls down the shaft and I cower.

lines.zh: 我掉进虚空，怀里的金子也散了。
lines.en: I fall into the void and the gold scatters.
